scope: 参数、账本对象、嵌套字段、标题与说明、源码变量/函数/类型/缩写、注释公式变量及完整源码入口的词义、身份、来源和悬浮交互；保留既有数字解释。

critical_term_oracle.R: num_ranks, participating expert parallel ranks; rank label R0 is rank index, not rank count
critical_term_oracle.E: num_experts, global expert count, experts per rank E/R
critical_term_oracle.K: num_topk, routing entries per token; invalid -1 differs from destination sentinel
critical_term_oracle.T: num_tokens effective input row count in this invocation, 0<=T<=M; not capacity
critical_term_oracle.M: num_max_tokens_per_rank capacity; all ranks consistent; partitions recv buffer and stride for source global index; not effective T
critical_term_oracle.H: hidden vector element dimension; byte count requires dtype width
critical_term_oracle.A: expert_alignment, output token count aligned separately for each expert, not address byte alignment
critical_term_oracle.C: num_vec_cores teaching label, selected vector cores per rank; 16 is chosen demo and source host lower bound, not universal device maximum
critical_term_oracle.SF: scale-factor packs carried with FP8; sf_pack_t=int16; opaque raw bit patterns, not decoded mathematical scaling factors
critical_term_oracle.gsge: global_sgep_idx within a vector core logical SQE space; *6+sgep; not across entire ranks or literal single SGE index
critical_term_oracle.SQE: send queue entry; dispatch writes logical/physical entries, physical entry is network queue location
critical_term_oracle.SGE: scatter gather entry describing source address and byte length; pair is hidden+metadata
critical_term_oracle.WQEBB: source constant queue granule 64B; dispatch reserved4 differs valid ceil((48+num_sges*16)/64)
critical_term_oracle.signals: teaching aggregation not actual C++ struct; local_copy_ready/metadata_ready UB, arrival field in other status packing
critical_term_oracle.arrival: local rank histogram packed high8 arrival vs low24 data; general arrival status contexts differ
critical_term_oracle.num_unaligned_recv_tokens_per_expert: raw per local expert count excluding per-expert alignment holes
critical_term_oracle.psum_num_recv_tokens_per_rank: inclusive counts per source rank to traverse source partition stream
critical_term_oracle.psum_num_recv_tokens_per_expert: prior aligned counts + current raw count; raw expert end, not conventional all-aligned inclusive sum
critical_term_oracle.recv_src_metadata: K destination expanded slots, global source index, last matching local topk j; cached uses preserved metadata
critical_term_oracle.metadata_send_buffer: metadata contiguous packed bytes separate from hidden; optional SF, weights and fresh topk/global_idx; byte alignment padding remains undefined
critical_term_oracle.epilogue_expert_counter: teaching representation of per-core predecessors count/prefix; not literal allocated symbol
critical_term_oracle.finalFlags: strong order/fence/CQE on last physical SQE; submission still not complete
critical_term_oracle.logicalSQE: lsqe index in per-core logical grouping; differs psqe physical compaction
critical_term_oracle.physicalSQE: psqe in networking SQ; demo one pair/path chosen mapping
critical_term_oracle.hidden: token feature vector payload, opaque transport no MoE computation
critical_term_oracle.weights: routing gate weights copied, no expert weighted sum in dispatch
critical_term_oracle.padding: per-expert hole may zero when enabled; token-layout byte padding undefined must distinguish
critical_term_oracle.handle: cached routing layout; freshness does not imply dynamic arbitrary change of topk
critical_term_oracle.Hcomm: external HCOMM interface/type symbol; full expansion needs verified primary source
critical_term_oracle.AIV: AI Vector, vector core; not invented Ai Vector units count universally
critical_term_oracle.SIMT: single instruction multiple threads; routing/dedup/statistics/SQE paths
critical_term_oracle.UB: Unified Buffer core local scratch storage
critical_term_oracle.GM: Global Memory device memory outside core
critical_term_oracle.DB: doorbell notification submits SQ progression; not data completion

reviewed_meaning_families: M是每来源rank分区容量，T是本轮有效输入，A是每expert输出行数对齐；combine同名输入行数另按函数作用域解释。
SF是Scale Factor相关数据；冻结类型sf_pack_t=int16_t，本实现复制pack原始位模式，未解码scale。
rank/expert/top-k、去重计数、两类前缀、核内逻辑SGE pair映射、physical SQE与64B WQEBB的不同单位和生命周期。
24种账本对象与28种嵌套字段的owner、memory、dtype、shape、路径和来源；signals是教学聚合，arrival字符串不同于实际packed计数。
重复源码字面按file/line及最窄scope区分，涵盖dst_slot_idx、token_idx、rank_idx、ptr、value、data、status、i/j与threadIdx.x。
完整源码注释的k、N、my_vec_core_idx、n_burst、burst_len、expert_count、my_expert_count有具体伪码角色。
普通bytes为容量/字节单位，显式SGE.bytes才是该源片段长度；普通source是来源分区/操作数来源，显式SGE.source才是源地址。
语言语法/类型与业务变量分开；AIV/Hcomm/gsge及队列名称没有臆造全称，未公开的get_iqent精确返回字段明确保留边界。
